title: Five hospitalized in critical condition after two-car crash on State Highway 359
excerpt: Five people were taken to hospitals in critical condition after a two-car crash around midnight Sunday on State Highway 359 near Oil Patch Road in Laredo, according to KGNS.
content:
Five people were taken to hospitals in critical condition after a two-car crash around midnight on Sunday, November 1, on State Highway 359 near Oil Patch Road in Laredo, according to KGNS.

Three women in their 20s were taken to Laredo Medical Center, and two 18-year-old men were taken to Doctors Hospital, all in critical condition, according to KGNS.

State Highway 359 was closed while investigators documented the scene, and the Laredo Police Department's crash team was activated to investigate, according to KGNS.

The vehicle makes and models and the reported cause of the crash were not stated in the KGNS report.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "5 hospitalized in critical condition after 2-car crash on State Highway 359," November 1, 2026
